title: mastixia pentandra subsp. cambodiana
intro: Mastixia pentandra subsp. cambodiana, commonly known as Cambodian Mastixia, is a plant species within the family Annonaceae. It is a plant used in traditional medicine, valued for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Mastixia pentandra subsp. cambodiana include reducing fever, alleviating respiratory issues, and supporting the immune system, while its bioactive constituents include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds. However, more research is needed to fully understand the extent of its therapeutic potential and bioactive constituents.
